title: Learning bass drum from Cantrell and playing by head
summary: He learned bass drum by watching Cantrell's stick signals; most early players, even George Lewis and Chris Kelly, played by head, while Peter and Manetta had schooling.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Now, I learned how to play bass drum on the Cantrell.

Yeah, Cantrell was the snare drum player with the Excelsis, see? Mm-hmm. Every time he'd, he'd give me the signal with that, with his stick that made me know how to hit that drum. Mm-hmm. You see? And I'd like to have to play bass drum that way, on the Cantrell.
Did he teach you to read music at all? No.
You didn't have to do that, no.
Not in the band, brass band, he didn't have to read no music, and not playing those bass drum.

In fact, I never did read no music playing this. Playing the guitar, playing by head. Mm-hmm. In fact, most of those fellas in them days, most all of them, played by head. You take little George Lewis, great clown that player, but he played by head.
You take, uh, the majority of them fellas like, uh, Chris Kelly and all those fellas in them days, most of them fellas was no kind of a readers.

They had very few readers in them days, but they all played nothing but that jazz by head. Of course, Peter here, Peter and Professor Minetta there, well, they, they came up in schooling, you understand? They had a schooling for, for music. See, Pete played any kind of instrument. It's likewise with Minetta. See, Minetta never done anything in his life but that. Peter, too. Peter never, never knows what a hard-to-earth work was in his life. That's all he done for a living. What you taking my time when we went out there and made seven dollars from eight to four, or eight to two o'clock in the morning, we had to make a big salary. Mm-hmm . Otherwise, I was, I got a kick out of it just to be out there. Otherwise, tell you about the facts about it. Just so I was out there playing. I didn't care if we was out there playing and drinking and intermission. We'd have our lunch and everything like that. Well, I just got a kick out of it, me.
